title: Govinda warns of ₹100 crore legal action against ‘false’ claims about court marriage and divorce with Sunita Ahuja
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Bollywood star and former MP Govinda has issued a legal warning against the circulation of what he describes as false, defamatory and unverified claims about his personal and family life. The warning comes amid heightened public interest in his relationship with wife Sunita Ahuja and recent speculation surrounding his equation with star Komal Rani Swarnkar . His legal notice states that those found spreading such content could face legal action and that damages of up to ₹ 100 crore rupees may be sought.

Adding to this, Govinda is currently hospitalised in Mumbai. All about the notice issued The notice, issued on Govinda’s behalf, cautions media organisations, digital platforms, social media users and content creators against creating, publishing, uploading, broadcasting or sharing material that is allegedly false, defamatory, malicious, fabricated or unverified. It also specifically raises concerns over the circulation of photographs, videos, audio recordings, morphed images, deepfakes and other AI-generated or manipulated content.

Meanwhile, According to the notice, Govinda has not authorised anyone to create, alter or commercially use his voice, photographs, identity, likeness or material relating to his private and family life through artificial intelligence or other digital technologies.

Notably, The legal warning comes amid recent social media claims about Govinda’s reported court marriage with Komal Rani Swarnkar. Previous reports surrounding the divorce between Govinda and Sunita had also made headlines before being disputed. The notice as per reports states that Govinda believes certain rumours may be part of a deliberate attempt to damage his reputation and cause him mental and social distress.

As per the latest buzz, As per details shared by Govinda’s team, the star may pursue civil and criminal remedies under laws relating to defamation, privacy violations, identity misuse and cybercrime. title: ‘Constitutional right, not charity’: Chirag Paswan backs reservation amid Delhi protest, asks for systematic demands
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Amid continued demands to scrap reservation, which prompted protests at Delhi’s Jantar Mantar on Saturday, union minister Chirag Paswan backed the system, saying it is not charity but a constitutional right granted to those who have faced discrimination.

Adding to this, Union Minister and Lok Janshakti Party (Ramvilas) president Chirag Paswan shared that the government would engage in dialogue with anti-reservation protesters. (Hindustan Times/Santosh Kumar) He underscored that reservation is not something that can be ended simply because someone demands it, but is a constitutional right that stems from the idea of bringing people from communities that have faced caste-based discrimination into the mainstream.

Meanwhile, “Reservation is not something that can be ended simply because someone demands it. Nor is it charity given to anyone. Reservation is a constitutional right. The idea behind it has been to bring into the mainstream people from communities who have faced discrimination for one reason or another,” Paswan told reporters in Bihar.

Notably, “This includes people belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. What is a Scheduled Caste? These are the castes that have been listed in the Constitution, with untouchability being the basis for their identification,” he added.

As per the latest buzz, “They were identified on that basis and included in the Schedule, and reservation was then provided to these castes. Similarly, there are Scheduled Tribes. These are tribes that have been listed in the Schedule and whose way of life, language, dress and customs are distinct and rooted in their own traditions.”

In further updates, Paswan noted that people from these sections of the society were identified and provisions were made to bring them into mainstream society, through the means of reservation incorporated into the Constitution of India by Babasaheb Ambedkar.
On top of that, He added that overtime these provisions have been strengthened and shared that poor people from upper castes are also made eligible to benefit from reservation.

“With the aim of identifying such groups and bringing them into the mainstream, provisions for reservation were incorporated into the Constitution of India drafted by Babasaheb Ambedkar. Over the years, these provisions have been strengthened from time to time. And today, even poor people from the upper castes are eligible to benefit from reservation.”

title: Govt teachers' body opposes notice to official over withdrawn student protest circular
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Chennai, The Tamil Nadu Government College Teachers' Association has condemned the state government for issuing an explanation notice to Joint Director of Collegiate Education Cynthia Selvi over a circular related to curbing student participation in political protests, demanding its immediate withdrawal.

Adding to this, Govt teachers' body opposes notice to official over withdrawn student protest circular In a press statement issued on August 22, TNGCTA General Secretary S Suresh questioned why the Joint Director was being singled out and held accountable when she was merely carrying out administrative instructions forwarded from higher authorities following decisions taken at a high-level state Law and Order meeting.

Meanwhile, According to the association, a directive was initially issued by the Special Secretary to the Higher Education Department, based on the minutes of a Law and Order meeting chaired by the Chief Secretary on July 28.

Notably, The meeting had called for interdepartmental coordination among the School Education, Higher Education, and Police Departments, along with the district administration, to prevent students and youth from taking part in protests and agitations organised by left-wing parties and other outfits.

As per the latest buzz, Following this, the Higher Education Department had on August 14 communicated instructions to the Commissioner of Collegiate Education, the Director of Technical Education, and the Registrars of all state universities, calling for an Action Taken Report to be submitted to the government on or before August 20.
In further updates, Acting on the departmental directive, Joint Director of Collegiate Education Cynthia Selvi had forwarded the circular to all arts and science colleges.

On top of that, The teachers' body pointed out that after the matter sparked row, the Higher Education Department withdrew its original circular on August 19. Furthermore, the Registrar of the University of Madras had also circulated the identical instruction to all affiliated arts and science colleges, calling for an action-taken report.

"When no explanation was sought from the Higher Education Department Special Secretary who issued the circular, nor from the University Registrar who also forwarded the circular to colleges, it is baffling why the Joint Director of Collegiate Education alone is being made a scapegoat," Suresh shared in the statement.

title: Bobby Deol admits to being stereotyped as villain after Animal and Aashram success: ‘I try hard to break out of that’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Bobby Deol is in the second innings of his career. The Bollywood star played lead roles, including romantic heroes, to great success in the 90s and 2000s. But his comeback in the last decade has seen him play powerful antagonists more than anything else. In a recent appearance, Bobby admitted to being stereotyped, but added that he works hard to break that.

Adding to this, Bobby Deol has opened up about getting a lot of negative roles. (Instagram/Bobby Deol) Bobby Deol on being boxed in as a villain Speaking on the sidelines of the Jagran Movie Festival in Delhi on Saturday, Bobby shared he has been flooded with villainous roles but has been making a conscious effort to break away from the image. “If an star becomes successful in a particular kind of role, they keep getting similar roles. That's what happens in the industry,” the star shared.

Meanwhile, Bobby made his comeback with Prakash Jha's web series Aashram, in which he played a con man and criminal masquerading as a self-proclaimed Godman. This led to a villainous role in the 2023 smash hit Animal. Since then, Bobby has played the villain in films like Hari Har Veera Mallu, Kanguva, Daaku Maharaj, Alpha, and Jana Nayagan.

Notably, Bobby shared it is quite natural that when an star becomes successful in a particular role, they get stereotyped afterwards, but added that he is trying to take on diverse projects now. “I try really hard to break out of that. I've just done a movie called Bandar, which was very different. Even within antagonist roles, there are different kinds of antagonists, with different shades. So I enjoy playing those. I'm also going to do a few web series that will be different,” the 57-year-old star told PTI.

As per the latest buzz, Anurag Kashyap's Bandar saw him play an ageing star who is accused of rape by his ex-girlfriend. title: 'Your angry face is their content': Delhi Police told how not to respond to new-gen protesters
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Delhi Police has remained at the centre of controversies as the national capital continues to see massive protests. Several actions and reactions of the police personnel have been caught on camera and gone widely shared in this age of social media and memes. To counter this, the police department has issued guidelines on how personnel must conduct themselves in public.

Adding to this, Delhi Police carry out a lathi-charge to disperse supporters of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) after they gather in large numbers and breach security barricades near Parliament House on DR Rajendra Prasad Road in New Delhi, India, on Monday, July 20, 2026. (Hindustan Times) The Delhi Police personnel have been asked not to engage with the protesters or respond to their questions or emotional appeals, the Indian Express reported. "Your angry face is their content. They are not fighting you. They are making a movie in which they want you to play the villain. Refuse that role," the police have been told.

Meanwhile, The new directives warned the Delhi Police personnel against falling for their tactics to evoke sympathy, anger or even a simple reaction. "Protesters may cry loudly, fall at the feet of personnel, or ask questions intended to create sympathy or anger, such as references to family background or salary issues," it shared.

Notably, The police personnel have been advised not to hold any conversation or "show agreement". They have been asked to respond when necessary by saying, "Please cooperate, we are doing our duty". Otherwise, the personnel must "maintain silence".

As per the latest buzz, The guidelines follow the NEET-UG paper leak protests held at Jantar Mantar, where GenZ protesters could be seen filming the police officers, sometimes provoking anger, other times just making them smile at their tomfoolery. Several content creators recorded the police reactions, which went widely shared on social media.
In further updates, The police have been asked to always keep in mind that they are on camera and maintain their calm.

On top of that, “A calm face gives them nothing, and police personnel are trained to have been asked not to say anything in such situations. They have been clearly told that no controversial clip means no widely shared video,” the report cited a source as saying.
The Central agencies had earlier issued an advisory to all districts, Railway and Metro units of Delhi Police.

title: Saiyami Kher on 'disheartening' failure of Ghoomer, says ₹1000 crore blockbuster doesn't gaurantee respect for actor
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Bollywood star Saiyami Kher of late attended the Indian Movie Festival of Melbourne, where her movie Pal Bhar Ke Liye was screened. This marked her second appearance at the festival; she previously attended it for Ghoomer. While Ghoomer did not perform well at the ticket-window, the movie received critical acclaim at the festival and from audiences.

Adding to this, Abhishek Bachchan and Saiyami Kher in Ghoomer. In an exclusive interview with Hindustan Times, Saiyami opened up about Ghoomer’s ticket-window performance, the importance of having a commercially successful movie in an star’s career and why an star’s credibility should not be determined solely by ticket-window numbers. She also spoke about the success of 8 AM Metro, revealing that no OTT platform was initially willing to acquire the movie until it became a hit on YouTube.

Meanwhile, Saiyami has often been selective about the roles she takes on, choosing characters that challenge her as an star. Her performances have consistently received critical acclaim, and she believes that while commercial success is important, it should not be the sole measure of an star’s worth.

Notably, Speaking about the emphasis Bollywood places on ticket-window numbers and how a successful movie could help her get more opportunities, Saiyami shared, “I feel Bollywood speaks a lot about ticket-window and your next movie actually depends on how much money your movie has made, which is a bit unfortunate. It's not very merit-driven but more of how much money your movie makes. But eventually, at the end of the day, it is a business. If your movie is not viable, then how will the producer make a movie? So for me, I understand the importance of ticket-window success, but I also feel that I have had makers who backed me in spite of everything."

As per the latest buzz, She added, "Like a movie like Ghoomer, any A-lister star could have done it, but R Balki sir shared, 'No, you will be the most authentic person to the script, and I will be disregarding the script if I get anyone else on board.' I have that sense of validation when big makers back me on certain projects, saying that we don't see anybody else on the project besides you. Everyone wants their movie to make money because making money means it's reaching a bigger audience. I think OTT is helping reach a very big audience which originally wouldn't be there. So, of course I want a commercially viable, successful movie. If I get commercially viable films, I will get more opportunities to do films that I want to do as well.”

In further updates, Saiyami also believes that ticket-window numbers do not necessarily determine the respect an star receives. Citing 8 AM Metro as an example, she shared, “I am satisfied with doing a movie like 8 AM Metro that became big on YouTube, and then an OTT platform bought it. That movie no one was buying until it became a big YouTube hit. I feel the respect I have got from 8 AM Metro I have never got from any other movie. That's very surprising because that movie had no rollout, no big names backing it, but it touched a chord with the audience, and eventually the audience is the king. That's where the respect comes from. There are so many films that make 1000 of crores, but then people are like yeh kya picture thi. They'll watch it but it's not like you are getting respect with some 1000 crore rupees movie.”

On top of that, Before Pal Bhar Ke Liye, Saiyami featured in Ghoomer, directed by R Balki. She played a gifted young cricketing prodigy who loses her right hand in an accident just as her international career is taking off. The movie, which also starred Abhishek Bachchan, received praise from critics and audiences but underperformed at the ticket-window. It later found a wider audience after its rollout on ZEE5, where it was widely appreciated.

Talking about the movie’s ticket-window performance, Saiyami shared, “It did very well when it went for streaming on ZEE5. Even today, I'll get like 25-30 messages from followers saying we really liked Ghoomer. It's very overwhelming. I feel, finally, even if it finds its audience, you feel happy; there's no doubt about it. But It's disheartening when you pour your heart into a movie, and it doesn't do good numbers.”

title: Kartik Aaryan undergoes successful knee surgery after on-set injury
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

According to a spokesperson, “Kartik Aaryan sustained a knee injury while performing an action sequence on the set of his movie. His surgery was completed successfully, and he is now back home, resting and recovering. He will be back on set soon.”

Adding to this, The injury as per reports occurred while Kartik was shooting an action sequence for his soon-to-release project with filmmaker Kabir Khan. The movie, which is yet to be titled, marks the star’s second collaboration with the director after Chandu Champion . Kartik is shared to be playing a kickboxing coach in the sports drama, which is inspired by the story of kickboxer Tajamul Islam.

Meanwhile, The star had been undergoing extensive physical preparation for the physically demanding role. However, he suffered the knee injury while filming one of the action sequences. Following the incident, Kartik underwent medical treatment and was advised to take rest after completing the surgery.

Notably, The latest update comes as Kartik continues to have several projects lined up. His collaboration with Kabir Khan has generated interest, particularly after the star’s performance in Chandu Champion . The soon-to-release sports drama will also mark Kartik’s debut as a producer under his production banner, Dopamine Studios.

As per the latest buzz, Despite the setback, the spokesperson has verified that the star is recovering at home and is expected to return to the sets soon. The development is likely to temporarily affect his shooting schedule, with his return depending on his recovery.

In further updates, Kartik was of late in the news after winning the Best Star award at the 72nd National Movie Awards for his performance as Paralympic gold medallist Murlikant Petkar in Chandu Champion . With his surgery successfully completed, the star is now focusing on recovery before resuming his professional commitments.

title: Sanjay Leela Bhansali to begin Madhubala biopic starring Sara Arjun in September
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

According to a report by Mid-Day , Bhansali will shoot the last song of Love & War at Royal Palms next week. Once the shoot is completed, the same location will as per reports undergo a transformation for the Madhubala biopic, which stars Sara Arjun in the lead role.

Adding to this, An industry insider opened up that the production design team will begin preparing the location immediately after the Love & War schedule concludes. The source shared, “After the ‘Love & War’ shoot concludes at the end of August, the production design team of the Madhubala biopic will start work on transforming the space. The movie is expected to roll in September.”

Meanwhile, The untitled biopic will be directed by Jasmeet K Reen, known for Darlings (2022). The project had earlier been put on hold as per reports due to financial challenges. However, the movie gained momentum after Bhansali came on board as a producer.

Notably, Sara Arjun has also started preparing for her portrayal of the legendary star. The source further shared, “Sara has started preparing for the role. Jasmeet wants to capture Madhubala’s personality, mannerisms, and the world she inhabited.”

As per the latest buzz, Sara, who of late gained wider recognition through the Dhurandhar franchise, played Yalina Jamali, the female lead and love interest of Ranveer Singh’s character, Hamza Ali Mazari.

In further updates, With Love & War nearing completion, attention is now turning to Bhansali’s next production, which aims to explore the life, personality and era of one of Hindi cinema’s most recognised stars, Madhubala.

title: Poonam Dhillon hospitalised at Mumbai’s Lilavati hospital after Dengue diagnosis
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Journalist Vickey Lalwani shared an update about Dhillon’s health on Instagram on August 22. He wrote, “Poonam Dhillon has been admitted to Lilavati Hospital, Mumbai. The senior star has been diagnosed with dengue and has been in the hospital for quite some days now.”

Adding to this, Lalwani also opened up that he had contacted Dhillon on the morning of August 22 to enquire about her health. According to his update, the star responded that she was recovering. The journalist subsequently wished her a speedy recovery and expressed hope that she would soon be able to return home.

Meanwhile, Dhillon’s hospitalisation comes days after she was involved in a row concerning the Cine and TV Artistes’ Association (CINTAA), where she serves as president. The issue began after eight elected members of CINTAA’s Executive Committee resigned from their positions and called for fresh elections.

Notably, In their letter, the members alleged that Dhillon, Senior Vice President Padmini Kolhapure and some other Executive Committee members had increasingly taken control of important decisions within the association. The resignations led to a dispute over CINTAA’s functioning and leadership.

As per the latest buzz, Dhillon subsequently responded to the allegations and shared she was 'shocked' by the claims. She defended her contribution to the association and shared that she and Kolhapure had been supporting CINTAA using their own resources and industry contacts.
In further updates, Amid the ongoing row, the veteran star is now recovering from dengue at Lilavati Hospital. Further updates on her health are awaited.

title: Ranveer Singh thanks Ambani family for backing Dhurandhar when his films weren't working: ‘Nothing short of a blessing’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ranveer Singh -starrer Dhurandhar , directed by Aditya Dhar , proved to be a juggernaut at the ticket-window. The two-part franchise broke several ticket-window records and went on to become one of the highest-grossing Indian movie franchises in history. Of late, Ranveer Singh thanked the Ambani family for backing the movie with conviction through their production house, Jio Studios.

Adding to this, Ranveer Singh in a still from Dhurandhar The Revenge. (Netflix) 'Dhurandhar was not an easy movie to mount' The star of late made a rare appearance in a Reliance documentary. In the video, Ranveer Singh also expressed his gratitude to the Ambani family for backing the franchise despite all odds, especially at a time when his films weren't particularly working at the ticket-window.

Meanwhile, Speaking in the video, Ranveer shared, “Dhurandhar was not an easy movie to mount, not an easy movie to execute. There were several challenges. Danke ki chot par jake to back the movie with conviction, knowing that if this pays off, we will be breaking new ground."

Notably, He added, “I was given all the love, all the support and all the encouragement. Even at a time when my movies were not doing well. You have ups and downs in career but to have received that kind of support meant a lot to me. It is nothing short of a blessing."
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Ranveer Singh Global (@ranveersinghglobal6)

In further updates, For the unversed, the two-part action spy thriller series, Dhurandhar and Dhurandhar: The Revenge, crossed a historic combined worldwide gross of over ₹ 3,000 crore rupees. The films were written and directed by Aditya Dhar and produced by Aditya Dhar, Lokesh Dhar and Jyoti Deshpande under Jio Studios and B62 Studios.

On top of that, Apart from Ranveer, the films star Akshaye Khanna, Sanjay Dutt, Arjun Rampal, R. Madhavan, Sara Arjun, Rakesh Bedi, Gaurav Gera and Danish Pandor alongside several supporting actors. The films follow an undercover Indian intelligence agent who infiltrates Karachi's criminal syndicates and political power structures in Pakistan in an effort to dismantle a terror network targeting India.

Before Dhurandhar, Ranveer's career was going through a sluggish phase. His films like Jayeshbhai Jordaar and Cirkus didn't work at the ticket-window. Since the star's previous releases had struggled to make a strong impact commercially, making the success of Dhurandhar particularly significant for his career.

title: Ranchi police files FIR against JPSC-JSSC protest leaders over Aug 21 police-students clash
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Ranchi Police has on Saturday filed at least three FIRs against 14 named and more than 200 unnamed persons in connection with the August 21 clash between police and JPSC-JSSC protesters in Jharkhand's Capital, an official shared.

Adding to this, Ranchi, Aug 21 (ANI): Students during a protest against the Jharkhand government following the High Court's stay on the cancellation of the exam, in Ranchi on Friday. (ANI Photo) “Three FIRs have been registered against 14 named accused and over 200 unidentified persons at Kotwali police station in connection with Friday's clash,” PTI news agency cited Ranchi City SP Paras Rana as saying. Among those named are Kunal Pratap Singh, Piyush Kumar, and Ravindra Paswan – leaders of the JPSC-JSSC Reforms Manch, which was spearheading the protest against alleged irregularities in Jharkhand recruitment exams.
Meanwhile, The FIRs were registered for allegedly obstructing government work and clashing with police, according to the PTI report.

Notably, One of the three FIRs was lodged by police against alleged miscreants for obstructing government duty and violating route-chart norms, another official shared. Meanwhile, the other two were filed on the basis of complaints made by indviduals, PTI reported.

As per the latest buzz, This comes after a scuffle broke out Friday after protesters attempted to burn effigies of Jharkhand chief minister Hemant Soren and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi, officials shared. The ruling Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM) party workers in the state also disrupted a statewide effigy-burning campaign organised by students, leading to clashes in at least four district headquarters in the state.

In further updates, Student leaders under the JPSC-JSSC Reforms Manch have accused the state government of “deceiving”job aspirants after the high court stayed some notifications cancelling appointments through the 11th and 13th JPSC examinations and the JSSC-CGL.

On top of that, The HC had on Friday stayed notifications cancelling the appointments of Child Development Project Officers (CDPOs) and those recruited through the JSSC-CGL examination. A day earlier, it had stayed notifications cancelling the 11th and 13th Jharkhand Public Service Commission (JPSC) examinations, and also stayed the order cancelling the appointments of food safety officers.

title: Union minister will meet anti-reservation protesters in next two days: UP deputy CM Pathak's promise to agitators
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Uttar Pradesh deputy chief minister Brajesh Pathak on Saturday shared the demands raised by students involved in the "reservation reform" movement would be taken up with the central leadership of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).

Adding to this, Uttar Pradesh deputy chief minister Brajesh Pathak clarified that the demands of the delegation have been heard carefully. (HT File) Addressing a press conference in Lucknow in the presence of representatives of the demonstration, Pathak further assured that a delegation of the protesters would meet a Union minister within the next two days, according to news agency PTI.
Meanwhile, The UP deputy CM also clarified that the demands of the delegation have been heard carefully.
Notably, "The demands of the students' delegation have been heard carefully, and they have been assured of appropriate action," Pathak shared.
As per the latest buzz, Furthermore, Pathak assured that a letter submitted by the students would also be forwarded to the central leadership.
In further updates, He shared that efforts would be made through dialogue and constructive initiatives.
On top of that, The movement is being led by anti-reservation activists, including Harsh Dubey, Shiva Sharma, and Mrityunjay Pathak, shared the PTI report.
At the same time, Dubey shared that the students had held a peaceful protest and their main demand was that all young people should get equal opportunities.

title: Govinda spotted at Juhu hospital amid feud with wife Sunita Ahuja, says he’s ‘fine’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Amid their ongoing dispute, Govinda was of late spotted at a hospital, though the reason for his visit has not been verified. The star's appearance comes at a time when his strained relationship with wife Sunita Ahuja has been making headlines, with both of them publicly addressing their differences and making comments about each other.

Adding to this, Govinda was spotted at a hospital. Govinda spotted at hospital On Saturday, the Bollywood star was spotted outside a hospital in Juhu, Mumbai. Govinda was seen dressed casually in a white shirt and jeans. When the paparazzi present outside the hospital tried to ask the star about his health, he responded with a simple, "Fine." Govinda's appearance at the hospital has raised concern among his followers about his health.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Buzzzooka Scrolls (@buzzzookascrolls)

Notably, Sunita was of late seen at a family court. Later, it was opened up that she was there to withdraw her divorce petition. During a phone conversation with Rakhi Sawant, Sunita claimed she decided to withdraw her divorce case because Govinda and his co-star Komal Rani Swarnkar were allegedly planning to marry. “Maine kal divorce case wapas le liya kyunki woh shaadi karne ke plan me the woh log (I withdrew the divorce case yesterday because they were planning to get married).”

As per the latest buzz, Later, in an interview with India Today, Govinda’s manager refuted Sunita’s claims and shared, “I am hearing this from you. Aisa kuch nahi hai aur nahi hoga. Koi doosri shaadi nahi ho rahi (There's nothing like this, nor will it happen. There's no second marriage happening). She is his wife, and there must be something going on in her mind that she made those claims.”

In further updates, He added, “They are both mature people, and while Govinda has never spoken a word against Sunita in public, she has been the one washing dirty linen out. I am sure they both want the best for themselves and their children. We don't know what came over her that she took the decision back, but we can hope that things iron out. It's also for the betterment of the kids, for they really get affected by all this negativity.”

On top of that, The latest round of their dispute began after Govinda was spotted with Komal at Mumbai airport. Sunita then called Govinda “Komal's sugar daddy”. Later, Govinda warned Sunita against defaming him and asked her to “stay in limits” while in conversation with the paparazzi.

The couple's relationship has been under public scrutiny for some time, with both Govinda and Sunita making comments about their marriage and differences in recent months. Despite the divorce-related developments and allegations, Govinda's manager has maintained that there is no question of a second marriage.

title: Taapsee Pannu says she’s never met Kangana Ranaut, addresses their past feud: ‘A reflection of our upbringings’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Taapsee Pannu and Kangana Ranaut had a public feud in 2019 and 2020. Of late, Taapsee spoke about her equation with Kangana and opened up that she has never met the star. She also opened up about the possibility of joining politics.

Adding to this, Taapsee Pannu on feud with Kangana Ranaut. ‘People can decide who comes from where’ Speaking about her feud with Kangana , Taapsee shared that the way they speak about each other is a reflection of their upbringing. She told India Today, “I haven't met her. I didn't meet her before when these so-called issues started. I haven't met her now as well. My opinion on her is reflective of my upbringing and my way of talking, my way of perceiving things and hers... she stands by hers. So, I think that's enough for everybody to look and decide who comes from where."

Meanwhile, Taapsee also spoke about the possibility of entering politics. She shared, “I am too honest and vulnerable for this. Also, I want to do a few more films. I am not at all considering joining and I don't have the DNA for that.” Taapsee also shared that she takes an interest in political issues and is vocal about them as an educated citizen rather than approaching such matters from a political standpoint.

Notably, Taapsee and Kangana's feud started in 2019. It intensified after Kangana's sister, Rangoli Chandel, called Taapsee a “sasti copy” of Kangana on social media. The exchange further escalated in 2020 after Kangana referred to Taapsee and others as “B-grade actresses” and “needy outsiders” amid debates around nepotism and industry politics.
As per the latest buzz, Taapsee, however, has maintained that despite their differences, she is ready to be friends with the star.

In further updates, Speaking on Shubhankar Mishra’s YouTube channel in an old interaction, Taapsee shared, “I don’t know if I ever fought. A fight happens when two people clash. I never clashed. You tell me — have I ever shared even a single line against her? Her sister called me a ‘cheap copy.’ She shared that since I don’t earn as much money as her, that makes me cheap. If she is such a brilliant star, I have no problem being called her copy. You can take out any statement of mine – I haven’t shared anything against her.”

On top of that, On the work front, Taapsee was last seen in Gandhari, an action thriller directed by Devashish Makhija. The movie follows a mother's relentless pursuit to find and rescue her kidnapped daughter, exploring themes of revenge and redemption amidst her harrowing journey.

title: Kareena Kapoor laughs off pregnancy rumours, reveals reason behind ‘baby bump’. Watch
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Kareena Kapoor has laughed off pregnancy rumours after a video of her leaving a gym went widely shared, with some social media users speculating that she was sporting a baby bump. After her team and sister-in-law Saba Pataudi dismissed the speculation, Kareena has now seemingly addressed the rumours herself with a humorous social media post.

Adding to this, Kareena Kapoor reacts to pregnancy rumours. (ANI Photo) (Sunil Khandare) Kareena Kapoor reacts to pregnancy rumours On Saturday, Kareena posted on Instagram and shared a picture of a man flaunting his bloated stomach, accompanied by the song Chocolate Lime Juice from Hum Aapke Hain Koun. She added laughing and pizza emojis to the post, seemingly hinting that the apparent bump in her widely shared video was simply the result of indulging in too much food.

Meanwhile, She was also of late spotted in the town looking chic in a yellow shirt and black trousers. The star completed her look by tying her hair in a bun. Her appearance shut down all the ongoing speculations.

Notably, Earlier, Saba Pataudi had dismissed the pregnancy rumours, attributing them to a bad camera angle. She wrote, “A bad angle ... Or a bad hair day! How can everyone assume another extreme!! She walked out of an airport looking slick, classy and slim, and today out of a gym! That's it!! I've been convincing my sister to have a 2nd child ... wish that was true! She'll kill me for saying it! Live n let live guys. Some things are left private. No speculation needed. With love n respect.”

As per the latest buzz, Of late, Saif Ali Khan and Kareena, along with their sons Taimur Ali Khan and Jehangir Ali Khan, went on a family holiday to celebrate Saif's birthday. Kareena later shared pictures from the trip on social media, giving followers a glimpse of their dinner dates and indulgent meals, including pasta and pizza.

In further updates, Kareena will next be seen in Meghna Gulzar's Daayra. The movie marks her 68th movie as a lead star and also stars Prithviraj Sukumaran in a key role. Shared to be inspired by true events, the investigative drama explores the complex relationship between crime, justice and punishment, as well as how public reaction can fracture societal opinions over a shocking act. The movie is scheduled to rollout in theatres on September 18.

On top of that, Apart from this, Kareena is as per reports in talks to star opposite Dhanush in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's soon-to-release directorial. The yet-untitled movie is set to be directed by PS Mithran and is as per reports planned as a large-scale mythological jungle adventure. The filmmaker of late provided an update and told Cinema Vikatan, “Talks are underway, we are looking at the dates for confirmation. Hopefully, something good will come out of it.”

title: Aamir Khan begins major weight-loss transformation for Ashutosh Gowariker's Lalkaara
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

According to an exclusive report by Filmfare, Khan has begun a major weight-loss programme as part of his preparation for Lalkaara . The physical transformation is as per reports an important aspect of the character, as the star is set to portray a 25-year-old despite being significantly older in real life.

Adding to this, A source close to the development told Filmfare, "Aamir Khan is on a massive weight-loss programme for Ashutosh Gowariker's next movie. Touted as a sports drama, Lalkaara will see the star playing a 25-year-old. Aamir is known to go all out when it comes to physically transforming for a role, and this time too, he is putting in a great deal of work to look convincing."

Meanwhile, Known for adapting his physical appearance according to the demands of his characters, Khan has previously undergone significant transformations for several of his films. His preparation for Lalkaara is now expected to be another demanding process, particularly with the story requiring him to convincingly portray a much younger character.

Notably, Penned by Piyush Gupta and Neeraj Singh, Lalkaara is set against the backdrop of Indian cricket and explores several themes, including rivalry, friendship and patriotism. The movie will also examine the human impact of Partition through the life of one of India's pioneering cricket figures.

As per the latest buzz, The reunion between Khan and Gowariker has already generated interest, given the impact of their previous collaboration, Lagaan . With Khan undergoing a significant physical transformation for the role, Lalkaara is shaping up to be another ambitious project in the star-director's association.

title: Shaan buys Rs 48 crores Palmera home, highlights Mumbai’s luxury housing boom
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

The residence has been created by combining three separate apartments spread across approximately one-and-a-half floors on the 18th level of the tower. Shaan’s latest property acquisition also adds another chapter to his family’s long-standing association with Bandra. His late father, musician Manas Mukherjee, had also lived in the Mumbai suburb.

Adding to this, Located at 8 Turner Road, near the junction of St Martin’s Road, Palmera is a boutique residential project developed by Pantheion Real Estate. The tower stands on the redeveloped plot that once housed the bungalow of veteran star Mala Sinha. Rising 22 storeys above the ground, the development has only 32 residences, making it a low-density luxury address.

Meanwhile, Palmera offers open-plan bare-shell apartments that can be customised according to the owners’ requirements. The residences feature private apartment lobbies, open decks and 3.3-metre floor-to-ceiling heights. Individual homes start at around 2,090 square feet of carpet area, while full-floor residences extend beyond 4,180 square feet.

Notably, The development also offers several lifestyle and wellness facilities, including a rooftop infinity pool, sky deck, gymnasium, Pilates and yoga studios, meditation rooms, spa, salon vanity room, business meeting room, banquet hall, game room, library, card room and children’s play area. Other facilities include a pet zone, EV charging stations and valet services.

As per the latest buzz, Shaan’s Rs 48 crores purchase comes amid strong demand for premium homes in Mumbai. According to the Lighthouse Luxury Quarterly Real Estate Report, prepared with proptech intelligence platform Zapkey using verified Maharashtra government registration data, Mumbai recorded 1,499 luxury home registrations worth Rs 14,903 crore rupees during Q1 FY27, covering April to June 2026.

In further updates, The quarter saw nearly 16 luxury home transactions each day, with around Rs 164 crore rupees in transaction value generated daily. April recorded the highest number of registrations at 563, valued at Rs 5,726 crores. Although registrations fell by 22.7 per cent in May to 435 deals worth Rs 4,492 crores, the average ticket size remained at Rs 10.3 crore rupees.

On top of that, The market picked up again in June, which saw 501 registrations worth Rs 4,686 crore rupees. The recovery was largely driven by end-user demand for homes priced between Rs 5 crores and Rs 10 crores. Against this backdrop, Shaan’s high-value Palmera purchase reflects the continued appetite for premium residential properties in Mumbai.

title: Dia Mirza says ‘there was no disrespect’ as she defends son’s ‘schooling’ of delivery agent after backlash
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Dia Mirza faced backlash in June after she recounted an incident involving her five-year-old son, Avyaan Azaad Rekhi, who as per reports questioned an adult delivery worker for using a plastic bag. Now, the star has clarified that her son did not disrespect the coconut water vendor.

Adding to this, Dia Mirza Rekhi (Photo: Instagram) Dia Mirza defends her son amid backlash for ‘disrespecting’ coconut vendor In an interview with Zoom, Dia opened up that her son had simply voiced something that “people in their entire life are unable to”. She also defended him against trolls who called his behaviour privileged and elitist.

Meanwhile, She shared, “Now, if a child is learning to say, 'We do not use this' - of course, everybody made it about the nariyal wala, which it was not. Firstly, it was not during the peak of summer. So, those who are worried about the coconut vendor coming in the heat and supplying this coconut water to this household in a plastic bag was his livelihood. It was all about the optics that were created around the story, which were about how it was elitist and it was disrespectful to the coconut vendor. That was not the approach of the story, nor was it the reality.”

Notably, She further shared that her son never disrespected the delivery worker and added, “Everybody who knows me knows how I treat people. So, I don’t have to justify how I treat human beings. The child saw a coconut in a plastic bag. The child recognised that it was something we do not - if we don’t propagate it. The child had the agency and the awareness to say, 'Please yeh wapas le jao hamare ghar mein. It’s not allowed.' There is no disrespect here either.”

As per the latest buzz, During the podcast with Soha Ali Khan, Dia Mirza recalled how her son Avyaan refused to accept coconut water in a plastic bag and asked the delivery worker to take the plastic bag and straw back.
In further updates, Soha lauded Avyaan’s conviction, saying, “Imagine standing up to somebody who is an adult and to have that conviction.”

On top of that, The incident sparked criticism online, with some social media users accusing Dia of raising her son with a sense of entitlement and calling the interaction with the delivery worker privileged and elitist.

title: Exclusive| Saif Ali Khan: Priyadarshan reminds me of my dad
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Saif Ali Khan is all excited for his next, directed by Priyadarshan and co-starring Akshay Kumar, Haiwaan, where he plays a visually impaired musician and martial arts coach. The star says interestingly both his director and his father the legendary Tiger Pataudi, are both cricketers who lost one eye but it did not deter them from making their mark in their respective fields.

Adding to this, Saif Ali Khan Saif says, "Priyadarshan is like Clint Eastwood, senior and calm. He reminds me of my dad. Both cricketers and both lost an eye but great in their professional space. Priyadarshan gives you just one take so you have to make quick decisions as an star and he wraps up shoot in time every single day."

Meanwhile, This is also his seventh movie with Akshay, ask him what makes them a great team and he says, " Akshay playing the villain elevated the project. It's the first time I'm playing a strong author backed role in a movie with him. He played my elder brother in our first movie together Yeh Dillagi and that set the tone for our relationship. We were new, weren't encroaching on each other and became good friends. I remember we had a 40 day shoot in Shimla and his Nepalese spot boy would sing Khiladi songs at 6am outside my room. I wanted to throw things at him because I just wanted to sleep." The star goes on to say that both Akshay and Priyadarshan believe Haiwaan is Saif's best work, “There is an interesting backstory to the character, his mother wanted him to learn music so he wouldn't get bored and his father made him learn martial arts because he would fall down a lot as a child.” He adds, “I too believe this is my best in a long time and cant wait for the audience to see it.”

Notably, While Saif isn't on social media, memes often refer to him as Gen Z before Gen Z was a thing. Be it clips of his old interviews or his humourous acts. A clip where Netizens thought he is seeking his own blessings went widely shared. The star says with a laugh, "It was a huge poster of myself so I was just wishing the movie and me good luck. I am childlike and a little mad. I've been in the profession for 35 years so I was a very different person at 21-22 years old, when I made statements that are going widely shared now."

As per the latest buzz, The star goes on to say he has been trying to be present in every moment and live life completely. Ask him if this realisation happened after the 2025 home invasion and stabbing incident and he says, "That could be true but it also comes with age." Back then there was buzz that he has hired high profile security, but the star continues to be his carefree self. Saif says, “I'm very lucky, that incident was quite close. The truth is I don't even like to share the car with my spotboy, I like sitting alone. I'm from the 90s' where we would sit alone doing nothing in between shots. There are a lot of people on sets these days and sometimes you just need it to be quiet. Things get crowded very quickly in Mumbai.” He adds, "I've never liked security but sometimes its necessary."

In further updates, The star just turned a year older on August 16. Speaking about the celebrations he says he rang in the special occasion in England. Saif recalls, "We celebrated at a close friend's house, where we cooked an Indian meal and had a glass of wine. The kids were playing around and it was a lovely time."

On top of that, Speaking of kids the internet can't get enough of Taimur, the mini Saif- the elder quieter one and Jeh, mini Kareena - the excited, expressive one. The star says, "All the four kids have very different personalities. Ofcourse Sara and Ibrahim are older and then there are these two. Tamiur seems quiet but not necessarily is that. I'm aware the internet is full of jokes about Jeh, the firecracker younger brother. We are just very blessed to have all this."

title: Priyanka Chopra says she wouldn't have loved Nick Jonas if he didn't respect her culture: ‘Really important’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Priyanka Chopra and Nick Jonas have been an inspiration for interracial and intercultural couples around the world. The two often speak about how they have found their biggest cheerleader in each other and how both have accepted and respected each other's cultures.

Adding to this, Priyanka Chopra on relationship with Nick Jonas. (Instagram/ EatTweetBlog) ‘Don't know if I'd love him’ In a recent interaction with E! News, Priyanka spoke about how important it was for her for Nick to accept her culture for the future of their relationship and shared that if Nick wasn't respectful towards her culture, they might not have gotten together. When asked about Nick's respect for her Indian culture and traditions, Priyanka shared, "I don't know if I'd love him if he didn't. That is a big part of any story or any relationship that is multicultural. I think it's really important to have a sense of respect for your partner's roots."
Meanwhile, The star also lauded Nick for helping to maintain the spark in their romance. She shared, "Being kind to your partner. That's something that's really important."

Notably, Priyanka was present at the premiere of the documentary Cycle of Love in New York. She served as an executive producer on the documentary, which tells the real-life love story of K. Mahanandia and Lotta Von Schedvin, who travelled across countries decades ago to be together.

As per the latest buzz, Of late, Priyanka Chopra penned a long, emotional note as Nick Jonas rolled out his new album Sunday Best. In her note, Priyanka called being with Nick the best decision she ever made.

In further updates, "There aren’t enough words to express myself, but I’ll try. You are what dreams are made of…Find yourself someone who not only loves and respects you but cherishes you like a treasure and isn’t afraid to show it. I’m so grateful that the universe led me to you. You’re the best decision I ever made," she wrote.

On top of that, The star also lauded Nick's talent. She wrote: "I’m so in awe of your endless talent. You’re the most honest and sincere person I’ve ever known.. and the most beautiful part of it is.. It’s just who you are. You don’t even try. You are the reason I smile every day. Thank you for being mine. These pictures are from our early days, but they still feel like yesterday."

Calling Nick " a secure person", Priyanka wrote, "I’m so proud of this album. You bared your soul in every note and every lyric. It takes a really secure person to be able to reach down so deep and share it with the world. I love you endlessly. Do yourself a favour. Grab the one you love and listen from the beginning. This is how love should be. #SundayBest out now."

title: Rajkumar Santoshi says Batwara 1947 differs from Dhurandhar: ‘Sunny Deol has played action heroes with dignity’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Right after Sunny Deol -starrer Batwara 1947 rolled out in theatres, comparisons between the movie and Ranveer Singh's juggernaut Dhurandhar ensued. Now, in a recent interaction, director Rajkumar Santoshi spoke about the depiction of masculinity in films and how violence is often being used merely as proof of masculinity. In this regard, he also explained how Sunny Deol's character in Batwara 1947 is different.

Adding to this, Rajkumar Santoshi opened up on Batwara 1947 being compared with Dhurandhar. ‘People are using bad words, drinking; it's so cheap’ In conversation with India Today, Rajkumar called Aditya Dhar “a very fine director”, pointing out the success of Uri: The Surgical Strike and how he has a different style. He also lauded Ranveer Singh's performance in Dhurandhar, saying he had “fantastically performed”.

Meanwhile, The director shared that he isn't against muscular action in films, but feels that violence is being used merely as proof of masculinity in films. He shared, "Today people are using bad words, abusing, drinking; it's so cheap. Sunny has played action heroes with dignity. He has played the role of a true macho guy. Those are powerful and memorable performances. We (Sunny and I) will do more action films, but with standards and class. Not to show off strength, but with good reasoning. There should be a good purpose to fight and hit a man."
Notably, Speaking about Dhurandhar, Santoshi admitted that a hero who has endured such torment and torture may react as Ranveer Singh's character did.

As per the latest buzz, However, the director explained that Sunny Deol's role as Sikandar Mirza differed from Ranveer Singh's Hamza, because physical strength was only one aspect of the character. The director shared he was more interested in showing the choices the lead character makes amid turmoil. "He is the most courageous character I have written. One can fight with a single army, or a group of people, but to fight and take a stand against fanaticism in today’s time, impossible. Nobody will dare to do that,” the filmmaker concluded.
In further updates, Sunny Deol and director Rajkumar Santoshi reunited for the movie Batwara 1947 after 30 years, following their last collaboration on the 1996 action movie Ghatak.

On top of that, Batwara 1947 received an underwhelming response at the ticket-window. Its total domestic collections stand at ₹ 34.47 crore rupees net after a week. The movie has also received mixed reviews from critics and audiences.

Speculations about Kareena Kapoor Khan working in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's next movie have been doing the rounds for some time. Now, director S Mithran has shared an update on the same. It was previously reported that Dhanush and Kareena are in advanced talks for a Hindi movie, which will be produced by Sanjay Leela Bhansali and directed by PS Mithran.

Adding to this, Kareena Kapoor, Dhanush to star in a movie together. Kareena, Dhanush to star in Bhansali's movie? S Mithran, who is currently busy with the promotions of his latest movie Sardar 2, spoke about the soon-to-release project with Kareena and Dhanush and told Cinema Vikatan, “Talks are underway, we are looking at the dates for confirmation. Hopefully, something good will come out of it."

Meanwhile, As per reports, this will be a large-scale mythological jungle adventure. According to a report in Bollywood Hungama, the movie is currently in the writing stage and the script has undergone multiple rewrites before being finalised. It is also expected that the movie's pre-production will begin in November 2026, with principal photography planned for January 2027.

Notably, If this project works out, it will mark a lot of firsts for the movie's cast and crew. It will be Mithran's directorial debut in Hindi cinema, as well as the first onscreen pairing of Dhanush and Kareena Kapoor Khan. It will also mark Kareena's first collaboration with Sanjay Leela Bhansali after their fallout in the early 2000s.

As per the latest buzz, In the 2000s, Bhansali had approached Kareena for Devdas, and she also did a screen test for the same. However, he instead went ahead with Aishwarya Rai Bachchan to play the character of Paro. In a chat with Filmfare in 2002, Kareena shared, “What he did to me was wrong. He screen-tested me for Devdas, gave me a signing amount, then took someone else. That was wrong, it hurt especially because I was at the start of my career.”

In further updates, Bhansali, on the other hand, had claimed that it was not him but Kareena who had approached him for the role. He did the screen test, but it was not a mark of certainty that she would be cast in the movie.

On top of that, “After going through the photographs, I told Kareena that I felt Aishwarya Rai was fabulous and perfect for Paro; she has the aristocratic looks I required. Kareena didn’t say a word then but some days later I found her lashing out at me in print. She accused me of backing out after having given her the signing amount and contract. Believe me, this is not true,” he had shared.

title: 7 Dogs review: Salman Khan, Sanjay Dutt compete for 'Most Pointless Cameo' in unexciting Hollywood-ish action drama
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Get Smart (2008), starring Steve Carell, was quite a funny movie. A spoof of the James Bond movies, it followed a bumbling spy who somehow had to save the day. I bring it up while reviewing 7 Dogs because this movie feels like it was torn from the same playbook. The crucial difference? Get Smart knew it was a joke. 7 Dogs seems blissfully unaware and is not even as funny.

Adding to this, 7 Dogs features an international cast with cameos by Sanjay Dutt, Salman Khan, and Giancarlo Esposito. What is 7 Dogs about? The only thing 7 Dogs' directors, Adil El Arbi and Bilall Fallah, manage to replicate consistently is the Hollywood feel of films built around time-bound missions. This story follows a cop and a convict who are forced to team up to find out exactly what the ‘Pink Lady’ is and, in the process, uncover the identities of the seven Dogs, a group of international criminals.
Meanwhile, The movie takes the duo across the world, in a setup that occasionally feels like a less exciting version of Mission: Impossible- Ghost Protocol.

Notably, One of their stops is India, where they encounter Salman Khan and Sanjay Dutt . This is, perhaps, the most underwhelming either star has looked on screen in a long time. For starters, there are distracting audio issues in their scenes, with their dialogue often sounding poorly integrated into the movie.

As per the latest buzz, The problem is that neither appearance carries any real sense of excitement or menace. They are on screen for barely five minutes each, and both performances seem to conflate animation with the swagger of a Hollywood action movie. Instead of making the India portions feel like a big international detour, their cameos end up looking like obligatory star appearances that the movie has no idea how to use.

In further updates, Oh, and then there is India. Even for a movie made in Riyadh, the visual shorthand remains the same: dingy, overcrowded streets and hungry children. It is a tired way of depicting the country, and one wishes filmmakers would simply move on from this overused template.

On top of that, The screenplay is also weighed down by forced humour, with jokes routinely inserted. The first half, in particular, is painfully predictable, offering little in the way of twists or turns. Robrecht Heyvaert’s camerawork, thankfully, brings some visual flair to the proceedings, with a few inventive shots. The action set pieces, however, are lazy, relying on familiar staging rather than finding ways to make the missions feel either fresh or thrilling.
Monica Bellucci, in a special appearance, gives us one of her laziest performances so far.

title: Arjun Rampal marries longtime girlfriend Gabriella Demetriades in Goa
body: Here's the latest relationship update doing the rounds:

According to PTI, Arjun and Gabriella completed the required marriage formalities at the office. The couple had earlier secured special permission from the Assistant Public Prosecutor of the local court to waive the mandatory 15-day waiting period between the first and second signatures required under Goa’s marriage laws.

Adding to this, Sub-Registrar Suraj Vernekar verified that the marriage was registered under Goa’s Uniform Civil Code. Arjun and Gabriella as per reports reached the office at around 4 pm and kept their appearance casual for the occasion.

Meanwhile, The couple’s relationship began in 2018, following Arjun’s separation from his former wife, Mehr Jesia. They welcomed their first child, son Arik, in 2019, before making their relationship official through marriage. Four years later, they became parents to their second son, Ariv. In 2025, Arjun revealed his engagement to Gabriella, six years after the two started dating.

Notably, Before their marriage, Arjun had spoken about his decision to stay unmarried despite sharing two children with Gabriella. During an appearance on Ranveer Allahbadia’s YouTube channel, the star explained his perspective on marriage and the legal bond it creates.

As per the latest buzz, Arjun shared, “It’s not me, it’s not her. What is marriage? A piece of paper after all. I think we are already married and there is no doubt in my mind about that. But, sometimes what that piece of paper can also do is change you. Because it’s like you think it’s permanent, it’s a false notion in fact but you are just legally bound.”

In further updates, He further explained, “It could change your attitude towards each other. I think that’s how we both feel. Whatever has happened between us was very organic. I don’t want to speak much about it because I don’t want to jinx it. I don’t think I need to justify this to anybody. For us, this is beautiful. You should keep experiencing it for as long as you can. In both our minds, we are married to each other. We are both pushing each other in the right direction and at the same time, we are boyfriend-girlfriend.”

On top of that, Arjun had also clarified that his views did not mean he was against marriage. The couple has now formally registered their relationship, marking a new chapter in their journey together.

title: Deepika Padukone met Sandeep Reddy Vanga 'only once', didn't even get narration: 'Would never work with him' | Exclusive
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

It was in April 2025 that Deepika Padukone decided not to be a part of Sandeep Reddy Vanga ’s Spirit. It is August 2026, and somehow, we are still talking about it. The star’s exit from the pan-India movie caused a huge uproar, with the filmmaker hurling allegations on social media and the industry debating work hours for artistes. The row erupted once again this week when Pranay , the director’s brother, claimed one of the reasons for Deepika’s exit was her demand for a profit share. Now, Hindustan Times has learnt the other version of events for the first time, as a highly-placed source close to the developments has informed us why the star chose not to do the movie.

Adding to this, Deepika Padukone was in talks with Sandeep Reddy Vanga for his movie Spirit last year. ‘Deepika never commits to a movie without full narration’ Hindustan Times reached out to a source close to the developments, who shared, “Deepika Padukone has met Sandeep Reddy Vanga all of once in her life. Not to mention, the filmmaker arrived a whole hour late to the meeting! Deepika took the rest of the meeting professionally. In the meeting, only a one-liner of the movie was shared. She didn’t receive a full narration of the movie. Deepika never commits to a project without receiving a full narration. So, Spirit was never a part of Deepika’s consideration set to begin with.”

Meanwhile, The source added that Deepika has no inclination to work with the filmmaker: “Sandeep Reddy Vanga is the kind of filmmaker Deepika Padukone would never collaborate with, given his misogynist nature: one that is greatly evident not only in his off-screen persona but in his movies too.”

Notably, Deepika Padukone was in talks with Sandeep Reddy Vanga for his Prabhas-starrer Spirit last year. But in April, it emerged that the star had exited the project. The star as per reports asked for a fixed 8-hour workday as a new mother, a demand that was not met by the movie’s production. The makers of Kalki 2898 AD also revealed her exit from the sequel through a post on X, sparking online debate about professionalism, work-hour limits, and remuneration in high-budget projects.

As per the latest buzz, After reports emerged that Triptii Dimri would be replacing Deepika, it was claimed that Deepika left the movie because she was uncomfortable with certain intimate scenes. At this point, director Sandeep Reddy Vanga shared an angry message on Twitter seemingly directed at Deepika. “When I narrate a story to an star, I place 100% faith. There is an unsaid NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement) between us. But by doing this, you've 'DISCLOSED' the person that you are.... Putting down a Younger star and ousting my story? Is this what your feminism stands for?” he wrote in May 2025.
In further updates, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Sandeep Reddy Vanga (@sandeepreddy.vanga)

On top of that, The row erupted again this past week after Pranay, Sandeep’s brother, claimed that one of the reasons for Deepika’s exit was her demand for 10% profit share in the movie. Speaking with NTV Telugu, Pranay Reddy Vanga added, “The reason is the same as what was already mentioned. One was remuneration, the second was timing. Apart from that, there are some other reasons, too. Soon after, everything went overboard. See, she can ask for anything. If we are willing to give, we can give. But the economics should also work out for us. We thought that it was not working. This is why we thought of other options. Once we started looking for other options, they started leaking everything.”
On Friday, Deepika liked a post on Instagram that called out Sandeep and Pranay for their stance, which lauded the star for asking for ‘what men routinely get’ in the industry.

title: Over 50 detained, crowd at Jantar Mantar despite no nod: What happened at ‘Reservation Hatao Andolan’
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

More than 50 people protesting against the caste-based reservation policy were detained at Jantar Mantar in Delhi on Friday as they gathered under the banner of Reservation Hatao Andolan (RHA). The detention followed a stand-off with security personnel in the afternoon, officers aware of the matter shared.

Adding to this, A crowd gathered during the “Reservation Reform Satyagraha” demonstration called by the Reservation Reform Alliance (RRA) against caste-based reservation at Jantar Mantar, in New Delhi on Friday. (ANI) The protesters had gathered at Jantar Mantar despite the police's repeated reminder that no permission had been granted to stage a demonstration there. In the morning, hundreds of protesters, mobilised by different organisations representing people from general castes to seek reforms in reservations and quotas, arrived at Jantar Mantar.
Meanwhile, Some protesters alleged that internet jammers had been deployed around the site, making it difficult to access social media from the area. The claim could not be independently verified.

Notably, In a letter, deputy commissioner of police (central) Rohit Rajbir Singh shared, "...for peaceful protest of maximum of 500 persons at Ramlila Ground for Reservation Hatao Andolan has been considered in this office and we have no objection..."
As per the latest buzz, However, the protesters, refused to leave Jantar Mantar and had a stand-off with the security personnel guarding the Jantar Mantar protest site.

In further updates, The protest drive was led by an Instagram page 'Reservation Hatao Andolan', which later called on its followers to participate in an in-person demonstration at Jantar Mantar on August 21. The page has amassed 5.6 million followers on the platform.

On top of that, The Reservation Hatao Andolan protesters shared the government should consider the economic condition of the candidates rather than caste alone. "A poor person, irrespective of caste, should be provided assistance for education, coaching and other needs," news agency PTI quoted a protester associated with the Akhil Bharatiya Kshatriya Mahasabha as saying.

Another protester demanded that the existing reservation system should be reassessed to ensure benefits reach the most disadvantaged. "Our contention is that the government should examine whether the present system is achieving its intended purpose and whether benefits are reaching people at the grassroots level," he shared.

title: ‘Assist the poor, irrespective of caste’: 5 demands at Reservation Hatao Andolan in Delhi
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:
Several protesters were detained by Delhi Police on Friday as a large crowd gathered at Jantar Mantar for a demonstration against caste-based reservation.

Adding to this, Reservation Reform Alliance (RRA) members stage “Reservation Reform Satyagraha” demonstration against caste-based reservation at Jantar Mantar, in New Delhi on Friday. (ANI) The demonstration was mobilised largely through social media by the " Reservation Hatao Andolan ", an Instagram-based campaign that had appealed to its followers to join the physical protest. The page has around 5.6 million followers on Instagram.

Meanwhile, One of the recurring demands raised at the protest site was that economic disadvantage, rather than caste alone, should determine access to government support and benefits. Protesters also sought a review of the reservation framework, changes to quota policies and greater support for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS).

Notably, Protesters argued that financial circumstances should be considered while deciding who needs government assistance, including support for education, coaching, scholarships and other expenses.

As per the latest buzz, "Our demand is that economic condition should be considered while deciding who needs government support. A poor person, irrespective of caste, should be provided assistance for education, coaching and other needs," a protester associated with the Akhil Bharatiya Kshatriya Mahasabha shared, reported news agency PTI.

In further updates, Another participant shared, “We are not saying that economically weaker people should be left without support. We are saying that assistance should be targeted at those who need it, including through scholarships, fee support and coaching,” another protester told PTI.
On top of that, The protesters called for a broader review of the reservation system, arguing that its benefits may not always reach the most disadvantaged groups within reserved categories.

"We have been raising this issue for several years. Our contention is that the government should examine whether the present system is achieving its intended purpose and whether benefits are reaching people at the grassroots level," PTI quoted a protester as saying.

title: Govinda’s manager denies actor plans to marry Komal Rani Swarnkar, shades Sunita Ahuja: ‘Must be something in her mind’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The ongoing marital tension between Govinda and Sunita Ahuja has taken another turn after Sunita claimed that she withdrew her divorce petition because of the star’s alleged plans to marry star Komal Rani Swarnkar . Govinda’s manager, Shashi Sinha, has now dismissed the claim, insisting that there is no question of a second marriage and expressing hope that the couple can resolve their differences.

Adding to this, Sunita Ahuja claims Govinda is planning second marriage with Komal Rani Swarnkar. Govinda's manager dismisses Sunita Ahuja's claims In an interview with India Today, Govinda’s manager expressed shock over Sunita’s claims and shared, “I am hearing this from you. Aisa kuch nahi hai aur nahi hoga. Koi doosri shaadi nahi ho rahi (There's nothing like this, nor will it happen. There's no second marriage happening). She is his wife, and there must be something going on in her mind that she made those claims.”

Meanwhile, He added that if Govinda were really planning a second marriage, he would have been the one to file for divorce rather than Sunita. He shared, “They are both mature people, and while Govinda has never spoken a word against Sunita in public, she has been the one washing dirty linen out. I am sure they both want the best for themselves and their children. We don't know what came over her that she took the decision back, but we can hope that things iron out. It's also for the betterment of the kids, for they really get affected by all this negativity.”

Notably, During a phone conversation with Rakhi Sawant, Sunita claimed she decided to withdraw her divorce case because Govinda and Komal were allegedly planning to get married. “Maine kal divorce case wapas le liya kyunki woh shaadi karne ke plan me the woh log (I withdrew the divorce case yesterday because they were planning to get married),” Sunita shared, explaining why she withdrew the petition.

As per the latest buzz, It all started when Govinda and Komal were spotted together at the airport. Following their appearance together, Sunita made strong comments about the star. In conversation with paparazzi, she called Govinda “Komal's sugar daddy” while questioning their equation. Later, Govinda warned Sunita against defaming him and asked her to “stay in limits” while in conversation with the paparazzi. He also claimed that Sunita was backed by a Bollywood gang trying to bring him down.

In further updates, Govinda and Sunita got married in 1987. In 2024, Sunita filed for divorce, and the petition as per reports cited adultery, cruelty and desertion under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act. After Govinda’s recent remarks, Sunita was seen exiting Mumbai’s Bandra Family Court on August 19, accompanied by her son Yashvardhan.

On top of that, Govinda’s manager, Shashi Sinha, later verified that she had withdrawn the divorce petition she had filed around two years ago. “It has been going on for two years, but it's finally over now. title: ‘Everyone can dream’: Conan O’Brien shocks Richa Chadha, Ali Fazal as he ‘sings Hindi’ in audition to be Bollywood star
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

American TV host, comedian and star Conan O’Brien ’s show Conan O’Brien Must Go premiered on HBO Max in 2024. Now, Richa Chadha and Ali Fazal are set to feature in the newest season. Conan O'Brien leaves Ali Fazal and Richa Chadha speechless The promo shows Conan eager to become a Bollywood star. He asks Richa and Ali, “I haven’t become a Bollywood star. Do you think I have what it takes?” Richa gives a savage response, saying, “Everyone can dream.” Ali adds, “You can’t just come in, pitch that you want to be a star and that too somewhere you don’t really belong.” Conan is stunned by their response.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by HBO Max (@hbomax)

Notably, Richa adds, “We are huge followers of you but I don’t think you are Bollywood material.” A shocked Conan then makes it his mission to convince Richa and Ali, saying, “I can sing, I can dance and play sitar with one hand.” However, Ali and Richa have only one concern: “Can you speak Hindi?”

As per the latest buzz, Conan then reveals that he can’t speak Hindi but “sings Hindi”. This is followed by Conan singing, “Namaste, mera naam Conan hai (Namaste, my name is Conan),” while dancing to the song. Ali and Richa are left too stunned to speak.

In further updates, The internet also reacted to Conan “singing Hindi”. One of the comments read, “That song is gonna be in my head for DAYS. THANKS A LOT, CONAN.” Another commented, “Everyone can dream. Such a dig at so many people ohh god (laughing emojis).” Another fan wrote, “This is exactly what we deserve right now.” Another comment read, “This episode is insane, I love it.” Another fan wrote, “Conan vs. Bollywood?! On top of that, Conan O’Brien Must Go premiered in 2024 and has since been renewed for multiple seasons. The soon-to-release third season includes destinations such as India, Morocco, the Netherlands and the Philippines, with O’Brien also exploring Mumbai and attempting activities such as playing cricket.
